name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in the goblet position at your chest or two kettlebells at your sides.
Step one foot straight backward onto the ball of your foot while keeping your torso upright.
Bend both knees smoothly to lower your hips until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to step back to standing, alternating legs on each repetition.
tips: Keep your front heel planted firmly and your front knee aligned cleanly over your toes.
Maintain an upright chest and braced core without leaning forward over your front thigh.
